query: How do review themes differ between positive and negative Yelp sentiment?

per_column.name: staff_attentiveness
per_column.rationale: A genuine service-theme axis useful for comparing positive vs negative reviews. Values are mostly well-grounded (friendly, professional, not_present correctly applied). However YLP-0003 says 'Service was good' yet the value 'prompt' asserts a specificity not in the text, a minor unwarranted inference.

per_column.name: food_taste_quality
per_column.rationale: Taste is a core theme distinguishing sentiment. But YLP-0001 mentions food items with no taste descriptor yet yields 'delicious', and YLP-0003 yields 'excellent' from 'Very good pizza' which is defensible; the 'delicious' inference is weakly grounded, indicating a tendency to project positive taste onto positive reviews without textual warrant.

per_column.name: food_freshness
per_column.rationale: Freshness is a plausible theme, but many 'fresh' values appear invented: YLP-0001 and YLP-0003 never comment on freshness yet both are labeled 'fresh', suggesting fabricated positives correlated with sentiment rather than reading the text.

per_column.name: portion_size
per_column.rationale: Portion size is a distinct, useful axis. YLP-0003 'small' is well-grounded from the smallest-pie discussion. However YLP-0001 'generous' has no textual basis, an unwarranted inference.

per_column.name: food_freshness_issue
per_column.rationale: Near-duplicate of food_freshness (nearly identical value distributions and identical per-row values in samples); adds essentially no new analytical leverage. Shares the same fabricated-'fresh' groundedness problems.

per_column.name: portion_size_satisfaction
per_column.rationale: Largely redundant with portion_size, using the same value vocabulary (generous/adequate/small) rather than a distinct satisfaction judgment; a mere restatement offering little new axis. Groundedness mirrors portion_size, including the unsupported 'generous' on YLP-0001.

judge.rationale: The columns target real theme axes (service, taste, freshness, portion) that are directly relevant to comparing positive vs negative sentiment, giving genuine grouping leverage. However two columns (food_freshness_issue, portion_size_satisfaction) are near-duplicates of earlier columns and add little. Groundedness is undermined by a systematic tendency to emit positive descriptors (delicious, fresh, generous) on positive-labeled reviews even when the source text is silent, as seen on YLP-0001 and partly YLP-0003, which is a hallucination pattern rather than correct 'not_present' behavior.
